params.body:
- The 'add via chassis number' button disappears once the sheet has a chassis number (fetched or typed in step 1); it had nothing left to add.
- 'overzicht' is a text link (ui-back-link) instead of a full-width button that read as the main action on phones.
- More room between the step groove and the first section title.
params.title: Vehicle sheet header: VIN button only without chassis, quieter back link
